steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dishwasher or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Remove RIF filter
steps.body: Remove lower rack. Twist and lift Removable Internal Filter (RIF) assembly per use & care guide.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove lower rack. Twist and lift Removable Internal Filter (RIF) assembly per use & care guide.

steps.title: Filter plugged or damaged?
steps.body: Inspect RIF screen and sump area for food debris, glass, or labels blocking flow.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Inspect RIF screen and sump area for food debris, glass, or labels blocking flow.

steps.title: Clean and reinstall RIF
steps.body: Rinse filter under running water. Clear sump debris. Reinstall RIF securely.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Rinse filter under running water. Clear sump debris. Reinstall RIF securely.

steps.title: F7E4 cleared after Service Diagnostics?
steps.body: Restore power. Run Service Diagnostics wash interval — confirm F7E4 does not return.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. Run Service Diagnostics wash interval — confirm F7E4 does not return.

steps.title: Escalate wash path
steps.body: Filter clean but F7E4 persists — run variable-speed wash motor test and inspect diverter spray zones.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Filter clean but F7E4 persists — run variable-speed wash motor test and inspect diverter spray zones.

steps.title: Run wash motor test
steps.body: Continue with w11366142-wash-motor-vsm and diverter procedures.
steps.oemOutcome: Continue with w11366142-wash-motor-vsm and diverter procedures.
